profile.headline: Your Expert All-in-One Accountant and Quickbooks Certified ProAdvisor that Writes
profile.summary:
I have a proven track record of delivering accurate financial data and maintaining impeccable bookkeeping records. With over 12 years of Accounting and Bookkeeping experience, 8 years of Quickbooks software experience, 10 years of Tax Advisory and Tax Preparation and a Bachelors degree in Business Administration, I have developed a comprehensive understanding of various accounting principles, financial regulations, and industry best practices. I have successfully supported small to medium-sized businesses by providing diligent bookkeeping, tax advisory & preparation, and financial analysis services.

My ability to provide diligent bookkeeping, tax advisory & preparation, and financial analysis services to small and medium-sized businesses has made me a very experienced copywriter for the finance industry. Not only do I know the accounting language, but the finance and legal language as well which helps provide more content for copywriting projects.
